messages:
sam: Quick postmortem follow-up. Last night's cross-region retry spike looks like a combo of TLS negotiation tail + conntrack pressure. Need concrete owners and short timelines.

olga: I'll own routing debounce + small prefix-cache audit. Plan: add 200ms debounce and emit `route.debounce.count`. Due Tue 2026-04-01.

teo: I'll take conntrack emergency change. Hotfix today: bump table size and GC threshold. Canary 10%->50%->100%. Followup load test with k6. Hotfix ETA today.

nina: I'll own cipher fallback behavior: map specific TLS errors -> fallback to TLS1.2 for affected clients. Canary and alert when fallback >0.1%. Due Wed.

ops_oncall: Log snippets during spike:
```
[2026-03-31T22:11:09Z] LB tls: handshake timeout client=10.3.2.1
[2026-03-31T22:11:09Z] conntrack: insert failed: table full id=66789
[2026-03-31T22:11:10Z] route: rapid updates service=edge region=eu-central-1
```
Added pcap playbook link and tagged node group lb-eu-central-1-prod.

deploy-bot: teo/conntrack-hotfix PR CI green. Deploy started by nina. ETA ~20m. :rocket:

sam: Ops - add scheduled query to flag cross-region retry spikes (10m window) and send weekly digest to infra leads. Also add incident metric annotation.

ops_oncall: Scheduled query `cross_region.retry_spike` added, digest -> #incidents-weekly. Annotated postmortem.

olga: I'll add a small smoke that exercises random prefixes during debounce rollout to validate no streaming regression.

teo: Will post k6 artifacts here after hotfix.

nina: Opening PR for cipher fallback now and contacting our CDN partner for mismatches.

sam: Jen? (tagging rollout coordinator) please maintain tracker and ping if dates slip. We'll review in next retro.

nina: Tracker: https://go.redwood/issue/INC-4999

sam: Closing thread unless regressions appear. :white_check_mark:
